sources.said: The ministry responsible for labour matters has developed an Online Work Permit Application System ( OWAIS ) that integrates labour and immigration permits. … C Non-citizens in possession of other professions 1000 … B Non-citizens in possession of prescribed professions 500 2050 (Non-citizens of Class B & C on Work Permit and STP) … an application for a work permit must be submitted online prior to the applicant's entry into Tanzania; … Short Term Permit (STP) An STP is a type of work permit, in practice it is applied at the Labour Department prior to entry of the employee into Tanzania. Although there is no statutory provision which specifically addresses an STP. … Fee: The applicable fee for an STP is USD 550. Timing: Approximately one to two weeks. Validity: Six months and it is non-renewable.

note: Read only in Clyde & Co's note of 6 April 2023 (the Immigration Department's and kazi.go.tz's pages don't load for this client). Applied for online on OWAIS (kazi.go.tz) before entry: the Labour Commissioner decides the work permit, then the Commissioner General of Immigration the residence permit. A performer is taken as Class C (other professions): work permit USD 1,000, residence permit USD 2,050. For short work, the Labour Department's Short Term Permit (USD 550, about one to two weeks, six months, not renewable) is in practice a kind of work permit with no statute behind it; the permit fields here are the STP's, the engagement a performer usually has. The National Arts Council's (BASATA) permit for foreign artists isn't modelled. Read 2026-11-04 on the Immigration Department's own fee page: the residence permit's fee and re-entry pass. The Labour Department's work-permit fees stay on Clyde & Co's secondary.
